segments.source: Discussion
segments.ko: Discussion

segments.source: Compute the element-wise product of two vectors or matrices.
segments.ko: Compute the element-wise product of two vectors or matrices.

segments.source: If either source operand is not a vector or matrix or splat, or if both operands are splats, the result has status LA_INVALID_PARAMETER_ERROR.
segments.ko: 이 키에 대응하는 값은 `NSString`이며, `AVPlayerInterstitialEventController`에 `localizedStringsBundle`이 설정되어 있고 건너뛰기 이벤트 상태가 변경된 `AVPlayerInterstitialEvent`에 `skipControlLocalizedLabelBundleKey`가 있는 경우 지역화된 skip label입니다.

segments.source: The two operands must have the same dimensions.
segments.ko: The two operands must have the same dimensions.

segments.source: If they do not, the result will have status LA_DIMENSION_MISMATCH_ERROR.
segments.ko: If they do not, the result will have status LA_DIMENSION_MISMATCH_ERROR.

segments.source: For simplicity, a vector of length n, a 1xn matrix, and an nx1 matrix are all treated as having the same dimensions.
segments.ko: For simplicity, a vector of length n, a 1xn matrix, and an nx1 matrix are all treated as having the same dimensions.

segments.source: If 1xn and nx1 or nx1 and 1xn vectors are passed, an nx1 vector will be created, otherwise orientation matches input.
segments.ko: If 1xn and nx1 or nx1 and 1xn vectors are passed, an nx1 vector will be created, otherwise orientation matches input.

segments.source: The result has the same dimensions as the operands, and each element in the result is the product of the corresponding elements in the source operands.
segments.ko: 현재 샘플이 `audioSamplePacketRefreshCount`가 `0`인 상태에서 독립적으로 디코딩 가능하면 커서를 다시 배치할 필요가 없습니다.
